normalization: normalized: Unicode NFKC, trim, collapse Unicode whitespace; comparison_normalized: normalized plus casefold

entries.jsonl.entry_id: Stable ID derived only from normalized
entries.jsonl.display: Canonical display selected deterministically from source occurrences
entries.jsonl.normalized: Case-preserving identity key; never a replacement for raw source text
entries.jsonl.comparison_normalized: Case-insensitive comparison key; never used to merge entries
entries.jsonl.display_variants: All unique raw display forms after whitespace cleanup
entries.jsonl.source_occurrence_count: All nonblank source cells mapped to this entry

memberships.jsonl.source_header: Resolved through source-columns.json by source_column; retained there once rather than duplicated per row
memberships.jsonl.raw_value: Trimmed source cell value without lexical correction
memberships.jsonl.normalized: Case-preserving identity key used to link the entry
memberships.jsonl.comparison_normalized: Case-insensitive comparison key used only for review signals
